classificationRules.CANONICAL_TRUTH: A world fact that must converge across both representations after canonical adjudication.
classificationRules.REPRESENTATION_ADVANTAGE: A superior expression or interaction that may improve the other representation without transferring implementation authority.
classificationRules.VALID_LOD_DIFFERENCE: A lawful difference caused by planetary versus embodied/local resolution.
classificationRules.DEFECT: A contradiction, regression, broken continuity, or lower-maturity expression not justified by representation or LOD.
